notes.title: DEMO now available!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645717/4d0a04b87ef95dc56bcaee9ce6d620a687aa1d65.png"][/img][/p][h1]GRAB THE DEMO FROM THE STORE PAGE![/h1][p][/p][p][b]The demo is now here! [/b][/p][p]You can play the main mode and feed Ghostie to try to keep him alive. [/p][p][/p][p]🖊️ [b][i]We want your feedback,[/i][/b][/p][p]Good or bad, please don't hesitate to let us know any ideas and opinions you have on the game.[/p][p][/p][p][i]We are still finishing things up and we have a buncch more game modes to come, this is just a taster.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645717/d093c960041a484ca73091264d85599e73c61b33.png"][/img][/p][h1]ːUltimateGhostː Happy typing![/h1][p][/p]
